Are you a Healthcare Assistant with a Level 3 Health and Social Care Specific Qualification (NVQ, Apprenticeship, Diploma) or equivalent experience seeking an exciting new opportunity to learn specialist skills in renal care?
Do you have the passion to provide outstanding patient experience and maintain high standards of care and dialysis treatment?
We are seeking a helpful, tactful and meticulous individual whom will be able to follow rigorous procedures to join our clinic as a Dialysis Assistant in North Devon (Barnstaple).
What can we offer you?
Here at Fresenius Medical Care we provide excellent and continuous Training and Development throughout your career, supported by dedicated Clinical Teachers.  On joining, you will enrol on our 8 week Fundamental Dialysis Programme, which is accredited by the European Dialysis and Transplant Nurses Association/European Renal Care Association.  Thereafter, we continue to provide training and education opportunities which help take your career to the next level.
We offer a competitive salary UPTO £28,500.00 - Progression through the pay scale will be underpinned by a Knowledge and Skills Framework (KSF) for each role, allowing employees greater career development potential, aligned to in-house training programmes.
Alongside this we offer a wealth of other fantastic benefits listed below:
• No Sunday or Night Shift Working
• Unsocial Hours Payments
• Company Pension Scheme
• Life Assurance
• 33 Days Holiday (inclusive of 8 days bank holiday) increasing with service
• Christmas Day and New Year’s Day off
• Overtime (time and a half after completing full-time hours – 150 hours every 4 weeks)
• Paid Breaks
• Free Parking at Work
• Health Shield – Company paid Health Cash Plan
• Long Service Vouchers
• Refer a Friend Scheme (£1000 per referral if successful)
• Sick Pay
• Free Uniform, Tea & Coffee, Flu Vaccine and Christmas Meal
• Cycle to Work Scheme
• Sponsorship for training where applicable for career development
• bhsf RISE – our Health and Wellbeing hub with 24/7 access to GP’s and Counsellors
• iChoose – Employee saving scheme with great discounts including phone contracts
What does the role involve?
As a Dialysis Assistant you will be working under the supervision of a Registered Nurse and as part of a multi-disciplinary team. You will:
• Look after individual patients, preparing dialysis equipment for treatment, monitoring vital signs and assessing, cleaning and redressing catheter sites as required.
• Liaise with patients, their relatives and other visitors to the clinic.
• Ensure that equipment is kept clean and supplies are well-stocked, safely stored and used efficiently.
• Keep documentation up-to-date.
• Administer medication when required.
This is a full-time role of 37.5 hours a week.  Current days are working various shifts between 7am to 6.30pm, Monday - Saturday.
Who is Fresenius Medical Care?
We are the leading provider of dialysis services to the NHS, operating 52 partnership dialysis units that together provide regular dialysis treatment to over 3,800 NHS patients in the UK.  We are part of a global company treating over 344,000 patients worldwide across over 4,000 clinics.
We also operate 44 production sites on all continents to provide dialysis products such as dialysis machines, dialysers and related disposables.  1 in every 2 of all dialysis machines used around the globe are manufactured by Fresenius Medical Care and we are the 3rd largest medical devices company in the world.
For more information please visit Fresenius Medical Care’s provider website: www.nephrocare.co.uk

mbda.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/mbda-uk/job/s.description_excerpt:
Are you passionate about executing and managing critical and complex Supplier subcontracts and relationships?  Do you have 3-5yrs experience of working collaboratively with UK and/or International Suppliers whilst protecting your Employer’s commercial position?  If yes, please read on:
Salary: Up to £45,000 - £48,000 depending on experience and qualifications.
Dynamic (hybrid) working: Up to 3 days per week will be expected to be undertaken on-site due to workload classification – especially during the initial 6-months to integrate with the MBDA Team
Security Clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship.
Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply.  As a minimum, and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.
What we can offer you:
• Yearly Company bonus: Up to £2,500 (based on MBDA performance and will vary year to year)
• Pension: A maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%
• Overtime:  Opportunity for paid overtime and Travel time.
• Flexi Leave:  Up to 15 additional days can be accrued.
• Flexible working:  We welcome applicants who are looking for flexible working arrangements.
• Enhanced parental leave: MBDA offers up to 26 weeks for maternity, adoption and shared parental leave; enhancements are available for paternity leave, neonatal leave and fertility testing and treatments
• Facilities:  Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more…
The opportunity:
Working within Project Procurement team, you will work with our Suppliers around the world and enable MBDA to provide world-leading defence capabilities for our Home Nations and their Allies.
You will lead the preparation, negotiation, implementation and performance of subcontracts across the entire life cycle of missiles and missile systems.  You will ensure that subcontracts are effectively managed to time, cost, and quality resulting in the delivery of high value and sophisticated sub-systems.  You will need to provide commercial guidance to internal Customers and manage risk and opportunity to safeguard the interests of MBDA.
Key activities on a day-to-day basis can vary between individual roles, but expected activities you are likely to complete:
• Preparation and execution of subcontracts, either with existing Suppliers or as a result of running competitive tendering activities.
• Oversee subcontract amendments to ensure they remain topical and in compliance with latest contracting standards and legislation.
• Undertaking performance management activities to ensure that Suppliers deliver in line with subcontract obligations.
• As part of a MBDA multi-functional team, develop and nurture strong Supplier relationships with Suppliers within the UK, Europe and the rest of the world.
• Regularly visit Supplier premises, whether that be in the UK, Europe or Worldwide as part of your role, carrying out Supplier assessments, chairing subcontract progress meetings or ad-hoc sessions.
• Identify and mitigate commercial and business risks relating to the Suppliers which you are responsible for.
• Obtain quotations and other critical intelligence from Suppliers which enable MBDA to bid for new business opportunities.
What we're looking for from you:
MBDA’s Project Procurement personnel provide a collaborative, team-focused environment where multitasking is a key skill.
This is a really key role, orchestrating the MBDA internal multi-functional team as well as the Supplier, so MBDA need proactive and dedicated people who can help us be successful by taking requirements and problem solving with tangible solutions.
There will be ample opportunities for you to develop within the MEP team, whether that be on-the-job or through MBDA’s excellent career development and training facilities, and across the wider Procurement business.
Experience and Qualifications:
• Previous experience in a Procurement or Supply Chain related role, ideally in a Defence or Aerospace contracting environment.
• Ideally degree qualified in a business discipline, relevant procurement or supply chain accreditation (e.g. CIPS) or equivalent experience.
• Experienced in:
• Negotiation in a Customer/ Supplier environment.
• Bidding to win against a context of global supply chains.
• Contract conditions.
Our company: Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given
MBDA is a leading defence organisation.  We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom.
We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more…
We recognise that everyone is unique, and we encourage you to speak to us should you require any advice, support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process.
Follow us on LinkedIn (MBDA), X (@MBDA_UK), Instagram (MBDA_UK) and Glassdoor or visit our MBDA Careers website for more information.

Job Description:
Your Impact:
IPT Lead Role Opportunity – Typhoon Development
We have a fantastic opportunity for a dynamic and experienced leader to join our Electronic Warfare (EW) Combat Air Sector, at Leonardo Luton.  The Sector is responsible for the leadership and delivery of multinational EW capability on both Typhoon and Tempest combat aircraft.  This individual will lead one of the key Typhoon EW Development Integrated Project Teams (IPT), responsible for delivering world leading EW capabilities into Eurofighter Core Nations (GER, IT, SP, UK) and Export Nations while also contributing to the overall Sector strategy for Typhoon and Tempest.
The Typhoon Development area is made up of several IPTs delivering complex activities across EuroDASS and the consortium partners.  This particular IPT is the largest and most complex within the Typhoon Development area with a portfolio delivering capability updates for 4 Nation and Export warfighters while also conducting complex obsolescence removal to protect future ac production across a multitude of customers.
As a Eurofighter programme, the role requires leadership and management of international partners in EuroDASS and complex interaction into BAES as the overall responsible for the Typhoon Defensive Aids Sub-System (DASS). It also requires leadership of the cross functional delivery team within Leonardo for its scope of work and overall system integration and qualification before delivery into BAES for aircraft integration.

• Ensure Governance: Apply effective Life Cycle Management across bids and project delivery.

• Develop Talent: Mentor and grow staff, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
• Think Strategically:  Help shape the EW Combat Air and the EW Line Of Business’ (LOB) future.

• Excellent understanding of financial controls and Project Financial management
• An understanding of business operations from strategy to financial delivery

Who We Are
FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
Are you ready to make your impact?
About The Role
The Energy and Natural Resources team is one of our largest teams globally, working to build and protect reputational value for an exciting group of international clients in the energy and natural resources space, collaborating as one global team in the markets that matter most to our clients. This includes companies across integrated energy, clean tech and renewables, utilities and power generation, and mining and metals too.
We are a fast-paced team delivering cross discipline communications support for a wide range of clients, from global leaders to new players. We deliver financial calendar work and transaction support, corporate communications and campaigning, as well as crisis consultancy, working with colleagues across the business to deliver multi-stakeholder communications, incorporating digital, public affairs, employee engagement and business transformation, and ESG. Operating as one truly global team our clients experience a truly international and specialist offering.
We have a genuine passion for the industry and seek to have a positive influence on both the sector and the society in which we operate in, supporting a number of businesses on a pro bono basis, including charity partners.
We are currently seeking a Senior Director to join our growing team in London. The role will support on existing clients as well as new business. The role includes the opportunity to work on global and  cross discipline briefs through collaborating with other teams and markets.
What You’ll Do
Deliver to Clients
•
Own and manage client relationships alongside senior team members; creatively prepare and deliver the client programme
•
Provide strategic advice to a portfolio of clients, manage accounts on a day-to-day basis and develop excellent relationships with clients and wider stakeholders
•
Developing campaigns and planning materials across clients which target multiple stakeholder groups and are multi-channel in activation
•
Supporting on issues management and working with senior colleagues to provide advice and develop required written materials
•
Deliver research and thought leadership proposals
•
Highly proactive approach to sourcing and creating client media opportunities, and ability to leverage strong book of media contacts
•
Ensure client programmes are agreed and project plans are in place
•
Bring a strong understanding of the news flow and media agenda, providing insights for clients to help shape their approach and strategy
Build the Business
•
Seek new business opportunities through leveraging network of contacts, and collaborating with colleagues
•
Work closely with senior team in developing new business proposals, and using previous experience to bring creative thinking and approaches to developing proposals
•
Proactively build relationships with media, industry and wider stakeholders, as well as potential clients
Team Involvement
•
Mentoring and training junior team members
•
Contribute to the team’s ambitions and initiatives to promote and improve DIB (Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging) within the firm and externally
•
Support senior management in ensuring team processes are in place and regularly share ideas on ways to evolve these
•
Share industry and media insights across the team
How You’ll Grow
We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.
As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.
What You Will Need to Succeed
Basic Qualifications
•
Experience in the Energy and Natural Resources (“ENR”) sector
•
Previous experience in an in-house communications or communications consultancy role; candidates with a strong capital markets background will also be considered
•
Existing relationships with the communications teams in the ENR sector
•
Demonstrable knowledge of the industry and opinion formers, including media
•
Ability to develop and execute high impact campaigns, and case study examples of successful previous campaigns
•
Exceptional writing and research skills, with deep analytical capabilities to distil complex information into succinct messaging
•
A strong media contact book across the ENR sector
Preferred Qualifications
•
Some agency experience preferred – with demonstration of an entrepreneurial approach which has delivered new business opportunities by significantly shaping the strategic thinking of a pitch process
•
Be curious about the world with depth of understanding about geo-politics, business and finance
•
Experience in supporting previous employers to enhance and promote initiatives to support a more diverse or inclusive workforce

Job Description
Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. We provide a full scope of legal services to the world’s preeminent corporations and financial institutions.
Our vision is to be a world class business, profitable, ambitious, cooperative and considerate, supporting our clients and people through our global business principles of Quality, Unity and Integrity.
With over 7,000 employees worldwide, our culture is the thread that connects us. Our strategy and culture are closed connected – defined by shared ambition, global collaboration and a one-team mindset. We believe pioneering work happens when people are empowered to think beyond boundaries, explore new opportunities and grow through diverse experiences. Alongside the right skills and experience, we are looking for people who are innovative, commercially minded, and motivated by the impact of the work they do – ready to share in our ambition and help shape what comes next.
Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.
The Role
The Finance Systems Team is responsible for supporting the core EMEA finance system (Aderant Sierra), including time, billing, expenses, vendors, tax and reporting. We are seeking a Senior Application Support Analyst, with Aderant and Finance Operations experience, to join our EMEA team.
This is a key role in supporting the day-to-day function of the firm's EMEA finance systems and will provide essential assistance to finance operations and other system users, including senior stakeholders in the firm. This will include delivery of ongoing system and process improvement and testing and support for new users.
Key Responsibilities
• User Support: support application users, and respond to queries and requests from fee earners, secretaries and finance operations staff.
• Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis: identify, analyse and resolve application problems, and minimise errors and downtime.
• Work with third party support providers, IT and finance operations to resolve logged issues.
• Application Support: lead the provision of advanced technical support for financial systems, their SQL environment(s) and related customisations and integrations, and oversee running of regular systems routines such as month/year end processing.
• Systems Configuration and Administration: configure system enhancements and customisations in line with user requirements and act as an administrator for Aderant Expert, iTimekeep and BillBlast to ensure the systems are available and meet business needs.
• Continuous Improvement: understand user requirements and requests, identify opportunities for system enhancements and work with teams to analyse, develop, test and implement changes.
• Improve and develop procedures and processes for all stakeholders.
• Mentorship: coach junior team members and provide technical guidance to improve team capabilities.
Skills and Experience Required
We are seeking a confident, proactive, and solutions-oriented individual with experience working with financial systems and finance operations.
You will need to be able to communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders at all levels across the business, including for challenging and awkward systems issues and stakeholder requests.
You’ll also need the following skills and experience:
• Ideally degree educated and/or 5+ years of experience in similar roles.
• Excellent customer/user service abilities, demonstrated by resolving complex user issues and working with challenging customers.
• Deep technical and/or application support experience and/or expertise in finance practice management systems (FPMS).
• Advanced SQL proficiency, as well as the ability to run queries unsupervised.
• Experience working within structured ITSM frameworks, such as ITIL.
• Experience within a large, global law firm or other professional services environment.
• Familiarity with core finance processes (general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, budgeting, forecasting, reporting) ideal.
• Solutions-orientated and proactive approach to work.
• Willingness to upskill on the job through internal and external training.
• Able to demonstrate a high level of discretion, sensitivity and confidentiality.
• Team player – flexible and willing to take on extra responsibilities to support departmental or firm objectives.

Alternatively, Grant Thornton
At Grant Thornton we do things differently - looking to the future, driving ambitious growth and pioneering positive change in our industry. Providing audit, tax and advisory services, we empower clients through strategic insight, curiosity, and genuine partnership. And we empower our people with real opportunity, an inclusive culture and work life balance. A true alternative.
With over 5,000 people in the UK, and a presence in 150 global markets, we're on an ambitious journey, from great to exceptional, and we need the best people to help us achieve our potential. And with that comes the opportunity to help redefine what our industry looks like, and what you want from your career.
Job Description:
Our Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) Tax team is structured in a unique way – we are focused on providing the full spectrum of tax services to private equity, across funds, deals and portfolio companies on a wide scope of transactional work both domestically and internationally.
We are leading advisers to mid-market private equity firms and large acquisitive corporates with deal values of anywhere from a few million to over a billion. We support our clients throughout the entire deal lifecycle from the initial proposal stage and assisting with offer terms, undertaking due diligence and advice on the acquisition structure through to completion and post-deal advice.
We work with businesses across a huge range of sectors – from technology and gaming, through to care homes, art galleries, travel and retail. This is a fast-moving and exciting environment. It is technically led but with a keen eye on service and so this role will involve technical tax application, extensive interaction with clients and great interpersonal and organisational skills.
TAS Tax are a small, tight-knit team, and have experienced exceptional growth year on year. We have a strong pipeline and as part of a growing team, you will have significant opportunities to take on responsibility and develop as the team grows.
We are looking for bright and enthusiastic individuals who are looking to step up into a AD role and are interested in a career in M&A tax.
We’re happy to talk flexible working and consider reduced hours and job shares and, whilst the hours in a project-based environment can be varied and, at times, quite intense, we’ll support you to balance your work, study and life.
A look into the role

MBDA are looking for a Test Subject Matter Expert for our Manufacturing Test Policy & Processes area. This role provides a fantastic opportunity to shape how MBDA works, within the Manufacturing Technical Experts and Producibility team across all projects from future concepts to series production.
Salary: Circa £54,000 depending on experience
Dynamic (hybrid) working: 3-5 days per week on-site due to workload classification
Security Clearance: British Citizen only
Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) Developed Vetting (DV) security checks, which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.
This role will require you to undertake DV clearance
What we can offer you:
• Company bonus: Up to £2,500 (based on company performance and will vary year to year)
• Pension: maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%
• Overtime: opportunity for paid overtime
• Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days
• Flexible working: We welcome applicants who are looking for flexible working arrangements
• Enhanced parental leave: offers up to 26 weeks for maternity, adoption and shared parental leave -enhancements are available for paternity leave, neonatal leave and fertility testing and treatments
• Facilities: Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more…
• Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more.
The opportunity:
An opportunity has become available in our Manufacturing Technical Experts and Producibility Team for a Subject Matter Expert in Manufacturing Test Policy & Processes within Manufacturing UK. As Subject Matter Expert you will be reporting to the Technical Expert and Producibility Co-ordinator and working alongside the Manufacturing Technical Experts and Producibility Engineers.
The Technical Expert and Producibility Team is involved in all aspects of manufacturing, testability and producibility covering product design, product testability, test equipment design and deployment, and accompanying policies, processes and technical standards. We engage throughout the product life cycle across multiple programmes, establishing robust and effective interfaces with product design teams to ensure appropriate manufacturing test methods, capabilities and techniques are considered and acted upon.
As a Subject Matter Expert, you will work on the following:
• Participate and lead manufacturing test activities for on new Manufacturing Programmes including reviewing BID proposals, advising on design for test, providing technical inputs on test facility/equipment design, and ensuring correct implementation / compliance with company processes through engagement with internal and external stakeholders
• Provide technical leadership and specialist expertise relating to manufacturing test in support of current Manufacturing Programmes including advising on technical matters, conducting detailed technical reviews, carrying out investigations, and providing support and input to all types of test documentation
• Undertake lessons learnt across Manufacturing Programmes with the objective of influencing future product development processes, embedding design for test into products, engaging in de-risking activities and investigations, and ensuring adherence to best practice across Manufacturing Programmes
• Concept and lead IRAD projects aligned to the needs of Manufacturing UK and the Manufacturing Technology Roadmaps; this will involve working within the wider Technical Expert and Producibility Team on projects with common themes and engaging internal MBDA stakeholders and external companies and academic organisations
• Lead continuous improvement and functional activities across Manufacturing UK, including technical, systemic and procedural improvements to BMS policies, processes and technical standards
• Identify and promote manufacturing test best practice and functional excellence across Manufacturing UK utilising current standards and peer-reviewed literature
• Strong interpersonal and well-developed communication skills, including written and verbal
• Willingness to travel when required, including travel across the UK and within the EU
What we are looking for from you:
• To demonstrate significant experience and knowledge within own field of expertise, with proven evidence of providing expert advice, guidance and support
• Ability to work in and provide technical leadership to high value/complex projects with the ability to win hearts and minds of others and guiding them through challenges
• Demonstrate a high-level of autonomy with the ability to conceptualise, plan and organise own work in order to ensure multiple tasks can be prioritised and delivered against Functional and Project objectives
• Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail capable of drawing conclusions/commonality from across multiple projects or teams
• Ability to communicate with all levels effectively; challenge, negotiate and influence to achieve a desired goal/outcome
• Act as a mentor for others within your peer group and across Manufacturing UK
• Be willing to undertake the United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) Developed Vetting (DV) process

Job Title
Cloud, Infrastructure & Security Summer Internship 2027
Summary of Role
A summer at Baillie Gifford could transform your career before it even starts. As an independent global investment management business, we have a Technology & Service Delivery department responsible for core technology platforms, end-user technology experience, IT support, digital buildings, first-line cybersecurity operations, engineering, and governance, which help Baillie Gifford operate securely and effectively. We support colleagues globally, and our role is increasingly focused on enabling the business to move faster, work smarter, and remain resilient as our technology landscape evolves. That’s why we constantly invest in our technology and the team of professionals who bring it to life. This is your chance to join us as a summer intern and show us what you can do!
What can you expect
You’ll be immersed in our technology environment from the word go on our paid summer internship. Expect to do real work and take responsibility as you gain hands-on experience with our technologies. You can look forward to being part of a refreshingly open, cooperative, and supportive team culture with an AI-native approach. Plus, you will get the training and support to broaden your skills and discover your future potential, including in-person, hands-on training with your new colleagues; platform-led courses from LinkedIn Learning and Pluralsight; vendor-specific training such as CrowdStrike University; and peer-to-peer collaboration. A summer with us will transform your skillset and CV!
From day one, you will join a team within the Technology & Service Delivery area. These teams focus on technical support, systems resiliency, and longer-term IT strategy and project implementation. You will work collaboratively with your team, contributing to live projects or immersing yourself in the team's day-to-day work. We will ensure you learn something substantive that you can take forward in your final academic year and future career.
We focus on understanding how exciting technologies can be applied to solve today’s business challenges. This programme provides hands-on technical experience across a broad range of technologies, possibly including Azure, Terraform, Docker, CrowdStrike, Superblocks or Wiz; all this experience will help make your CV stand out from the crowd!
Your internship will start with structured overviews that introduce you to our business. Following induction, you and your fellow interns will work together on a live technical project(s) for the firm. We’ll ensure you spend quality time with our experienced technical and business leads, who will share their knowledge and support you throughout the process.
Running alongside your project(s), you will have various development opportunities with other teams across our technology departments, ensuring broad exposure to the range of careers possible in tech. During your first weeks, you will build relationships and learn about the tech we use, which will feel very different to the learning opportunities that university life provides.
We will give you complete work experience to help you decide whether a career in technology is right for you. You’ll get the training and support you need to broaden your skills, establish your career path and discover your future potential.
If your cohort completes its core project ahead of schedule, you’ll be encouraged to proactively seek out further opportunities to contribute across your team or department. With support from colleagues, you’ll be able to explore work that aligns with your interests and development goals while responding to the priorities and needs of the business.
The type of Candidate that we’re looking for
•
A penultimate (second last) year student studying for a technology-related degree, with a proven interest in Cloud, Infrastructure and/or Cybersecurity
•
A passion for technology – we’re looking for people who have a genuine interest in how we can harness the benefits of technology to impact everything we do positively.
•
A desire to learn requires a thirst for learning and a willingness to embrace challenges.
•
Great relationship and networking skills – the internship involves building strong relationships and working collaboratively across teams, so you’ll need to be able to work with a range of people at all levels and operate effectively whilst outside of your technical comfort zone.
•
Critical thinking, you will enjoy problem-solving. We’re looking for people who enjoy working with complex scenarios and can collaborate with others to deliver a project successfully, always asking ‘why?’
Critical Skills
•
Adaptability
•
Digital Effectiveness (incl. AI)
•
Team Working
•
Systems Thinking
•
Improvement Mindset
•
Nurturing Relationships
You can apply for only one of our two internship programmes, so please carefully consider which programme most closely aligns with your career aspirations.
To apply, you will share your CV and complete a short questionnaire and one scored question. We encourage you to carefully consider your answer to the scored question so that it demonstrates your way of thinking and feels authentic to you.
Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives. In turn, Baillie Gifford does not use any AI in our recruitment processes.
Please note that, due to the programme's short-term nature, Baillie Gifford cannot sponsor visas. All applicants must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for the programmes. Our internship is based in Edinburgh and, due to its short duration, is an on-site opportunity. You must be comfortable being based in Edinburgh for the entire duration, between mid-June and late August, and sourcing your own accommodation in the Edinburgh area, if you are not based locally.
The project(s) and team our interns join are determined by business demands at the time of onboarding. No guarantee is provided regarding the specific technical team to which interns will be onboarded.
Closing Date
November 3, 2026
At Baillie Gifford we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.
If you are currently working at Baillie Gifford as an employee or contractor please apply to this job from the firm's Workday internal career site.

Our stores are the life and soul of our business.  They act as our main touch points with our ever evolving consumer base. As the world of retail evolves, we, as a business, believe that for all other parts of the chain to work, our stores must set the tone of what our two brands are all about.  Irrespective of where our consumers eventually make a purchase, our stores, are always a window to our great brands.  As a result our locations are paramount, the first class experience must be a given and our in-store standards should never be questionable.
To deliver this, we strive to hire the individuals who live and breathe the values of our business; who are obsessed with delivering great service to our customers and who truly believe that to remain relevant in today’s world, we must be nimble and adapt to change and evolution.
The Supervisor plays a key role in achieving these standards, they lead by example, embrace our entrepreneurial spirit and inspire their teams through their passion and belief in our brands.
Responsibilities include:
• Ensure the efficient running of the shop floor, in order to achieve the highest levels of customer service, sales and profit.
• Support the management team managing all personnel, product & merchandising functions, business processes and results for the store.
• Participate in weekly management meetings and other staff meetings.
• Clearly communicate to staff all marketing and sales promotions.
• Driving shop floor sales and exceeding store targets through motivating the team to achieve these goals, whilst offering our customers’ an exemplary store journey.
• Consistently foster a positive store experience by treating all customers and colleagues in a fair and consistent manner.
• Support the team in delivering the business strategy, and ensuring everyone has received consistent training on product knowledge and store maintenance.
• Achieve company standards/goals for personal sales results: sales v budgets, sales per hour and units per transaction.
• Perform manager-on-duty functions, manage store opening/closing functions and the sales floor.
• Focus staff on the importance of quality relationships with internal & external customers.
• Ensure staff accountability of building a repeat customer base by providing all customers with unparalleled spirited service.
• Ensure “door to floor” best practices with visual merchandising directives for sales floor and back room are being executed; continually review these to ensure they are consistent.
• Work with the management team to build a talent pool for key positions, including possible successors.
About YOU
• You'll have a previous track record of supervisory or specialist roles within a premium or luxury brand.
• You'll have previous people management experience with the ability to resolve conflict and unproductive disagreements.
• You'll be an effective communicator with the ability to build relationships with ease.
• You'll be a team player who recognises and celebrates the contributions and achievements of others.
• You'll be confident in giving feedback that promotes positive behavioral change.
• You will work well with change, being able to quickly adapt and work with pace.

Location: London, UK
Competitive Salary & Excellent Company Benefits
Application Closing Date: 2nd November 2026
Introduction to the role
Are you passionate about helping people use AI to work smarter, faster and more effectively? Do you enjoy turning complex business challenges into practical solutions that colleagues can use every day?
As AI Activation Specialist within AstraZeneca’s Innovation & Business Excellence (IBEX) Directorate, you will be a hands-on AI builder, coach and change agent. You will make AI simple, safe and scalable by translating business needs and complex ways of working into practical prompts, knowledge assets, automations and agentic workflows.
Acting as an internal AI personal trainer, you will build colleague confidence through AI clinics, training programmes and practical coaching. You will help teams move from experimentation to consistent and effective use of approved AI tools, while ensuring appropriate governance, evaluation, human oversight and responsible AI principles are embedded in everything we do.
This role is an opportunity to create meaningful impact across the organisation. Rather than solving individual use cases in isolation, you will develop reusable assets, playbooks, prompt patterns and AI Hub content that enable teams to adopt proven approaches at scale. By identifying opportunities within the Activity Map, prototyping solutions and codifying successful practices, you will reduce duplication, limit shadow AI and accelerate the adoption of governed AI capabilities.
Success in this role will be demonstrated through increased AI confidence and adoption, measurable improvements in productivity and process performance, reliable and high-quality AI outputs, and the growth of a community of colleagues able to apply AI safely and effectively in their everyday work.
Accountabilities
Drive adoption and scale of existing AI tools and services
You will develop and maintain a high-quality, reusable library of prompts for key business activities, including pre-approved prompt templates, grounding approaches and evaluation frameworks that support safe and reliable use of AI. You will run tool training programmes, codify best practice and continuously update the AI Hub with new tools, resources and leading use cases.
Working closely with business teams, you will identify successful AI applications and translate them into repeatable solutions that can be shared across teams. You will also support AI champions and users to scale solutions and embed effective ways of working.
Your impact will be measured through the reuse of AI prompts and components, adoption and engagement with AI Hub content, reductions in time-to-first-value for AI use cases, and the proportion of priority workflows supported by reusable AI assets.
Enable colleagues to unlock best-in-class use of AI and agents
You will run regular AI clinics to identify opportunities to simplify workflows and solve real business problems. Acting as a trusted coach and AI personal trainer, you will support colleagues in applying approved AI tools to their day-to-day roles.
You will design and deliver structured training programmes and immersion sessions for different user groups, helping colleagues build practical capability and confidence. You will also support teams in rapidly prototyping and deploying AI-enabled workflows, providing guidance on safe, compliant and effective use in line with relevant governance frameworks.

Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.
JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY
The Assistant Manager is responsible for coordinating and delivering the leasing and reservations activities, and assisting the Community Manager in the day to day management of this portfolio to achieve budgeted revenue, occupancy priorities, resident retention and leasing goals and objectives.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Key Role Responsibilities
• Acts as a role model at all times by demonstrating the core values.
• Responsible for viewing activities ensuring that the Property meets the required Company standards, follow up calls are carried out and feedback is received following all viewings.
• Actively participates in the leasing process by generating and monitoring traffic, qualifying prospects, preparing tenancy documentation, and completing move-in/move-out and notice to vacate procedures in accordance with established policies and procedures.
• Uses the Company’s property systems to generate sales and leasing reports, monitor unit availability data, log and monitor maintenance requests and record incidents and accidents, ensuring records and documents are accurate and up to date.
• Actively seeks interaction with residents to proactively seek to improve service delivery.
• Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by ensuring a timely response to questions, requests and complaints and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
• Oversees on-site enquiries, ensuring an appropriate inventory of “ready” apartments, recommending rent pricing and concessions, and monitoring the day-to-day sales and leasing activities.
• Ensures advertising and promotional activities are effectively implemented.
• Develops and maintains local knowledge and information resources relevant to resident needs i.e. travel, entertainment and amenities.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and results.
• Co-ordinates the tenancy management process by making periodic apartment inspections, evicting residents, and imposing and collecting late fees and other charges within the terms of the agreement. Monitors lease/tenancy agreement terms expirations to control vacancy exposure.
• Monitors payments and chases outstanding rent arrears following rent collection processes to meet business goals whilst promoting tenancy extensions and other revenue streams.
• Works with the maintenance team to ensure the physical aspects of the community meet the Company’s standards for overall appearance and co-ordinates and inspects show flats for market alignment and touring prospective residents.
• Works with the Community Manager to engage and motivate the team to achieve leasing and occupancy targets.
• Assists the Community Manager in developing the capability of Team Members in order to meet key performance goals and future succession requirements, coordinating with Learning & Development to ensure training is provided and addresses performance if required.
• Assists the Community Manager with ensuring on-site team’s understanding of applicable statutory UK tenancy legislation, Health and Safety compliance and Company’s policies and procedures.
• Promotes investor satisfaction and retention through timely reporting about the performance of the properties, and responds quickly and with urgency to client/owner concerns, questions, issues, and requests.
• Reviews and analyses financial and other operational reports to identify and resolve issues impacting leasing performance, and accesses the Company’s internal resources as needed to support solutions.
• Identify and implement opportunities for generating revenue streams and maximise efficiency of utilities.
• Acts up covering the Community Manager responsibilities’ in his or her absence, ensuring work is organised and executed in line with Greystar expectations.
• Participates where required in an on call roster to provide out of hours emergency support for the Community.
• Ensures the operation of the Community complies with Company policies and procedures and any laws and regulations governing housing operations and residential lettings.
Knowledge & Qualifications
• Good level of general education.
• Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office packages including Word, Excel and Outlook.
• Proficiency in using property operations software. Training will however, be provided.
Experience & Skills
Essential
• Experience of successfully driving leasing/sales performance and managing operations including P&L responsibility and budget monitoring within the property sector or similar environment.
• Detailed knowledge of Landlord/Tenant Legislation.
• A strong team player but capable of working autonomously and taking ownership.
• Flexible approach to working in a fast-paced environment and adaptable to thriving in a changing environment.
• Self and culturally aware and able to adapt relationship building, communications and negotiation skills to suit audience.
• Fluent English verbal and written communication skills.
• Excellent organisation skills with the ability to multi task and prioritise.
• Numerical skills necessary to complete the above activities.
• Enthusiasm to deliver an exceptional experience to stakeholders and continuously improve knowledge of self and others.
Desirable
• Demonstrable ability to coach and mentor team members.
• Experience of motivating a team and a proven track record in delivering service excellence in a similar management role/ environment.
• A knowledge and understanding of UK Health and Safety policies.

Engineering Chargehand - Selby Depot
Hourly salary: £20 per hour
The Engineering Chargehand provides day-to-day technical supervision and support within the workshop, ensuring maintenance, servicing, inspections and repairs are completed safely, efficiently and to the required company, DVSA and operator licence standards.
The role supports workshop performance, fleet availability and first-time quality by allocating work, providing technical guidance, completing quality checks and acting as a key link between engineering management and the engineering team.
Working hours
The role will operate in line with the agreed depot shift pattern, which may include AM/PM shifts, weekend working and rostered rest days. The specific working pattern will be confirmed contractually and may be subject to reasonable change following appropriate consultation.
Key responsibilities
Leadership and supervision
• Allocate and prioritise daily workloads to ensure scheduled maintenance, inspections and defect repairs are completed safely and efficiently.
• Provide day-to-day supervisory and technical direction to engineers, technicians and apprentices on the workshop floor.
• Act as the first point of contact for technical escalation and provide hands-on diagnostic support where required.
• Monitor workshop progress, productivity and quality of work, escalating concerns to the Engineering Manager where standards, timescales or behaviours require management intervention.
• Deputise for the Engineering Manager or Assistant Engineering Manager during absences or out-of-hours shifts, within the limits of delegated authority.
Technical maintenance and diagnostics
• Oversee and actively participate in the inspection, diagnosis, maintenance and repair of the depot fleet.
• Support maximum fleet availability to meet daily run-out requirements and wider operational needs.
• Ensure vehicles are prepared to DVSA MOT standards and that first-time quality standards are consistently maintained.
• Lead by example on technical standards, including complex mechanical, electrical and diagnostic fault-finding.
Safety, quality and compliance
• Promote and enforce a strong health, safety and compliance culture within the workshop.
• Ensure all work is undertaken in line with company policies, safe systems of work, risk assessments, standard operating procedures and relevant legislation.
• Ensure statutory inspections are completed within required timescales and that any defects or compliance risks are escalated promptly.
• Conduct quality control checks on completed work to ensure repairs are safe, reliable and compliant with Arriva engineering standards.
Operational coordination
• Liaise with the operations team to communicate vehicle availability, potential shortages, estimated repair times and operational constraints.
• Support effective planning of workshop activity to minimise vehicle downtime and maintain service reliability.
• Assist with workshop inventory, parts ordering where required, and accurate booking out of materials to the appropriate vehicle assets.
Records, systems and escalation
• Maintain accurate and timely records of maintenance, inspection and repair activity on the relevant fleet management systems.
• Ensure records provide full traceability and support legal, operator licence and audit requirements.
• Escalate employee relations, disciplinary, grievance, absence or formal performance matters to the Engineering Manager in line with company policy, unless specific authority has been delegated.
Qualifications and experience
Technical qualification — Essential
Minimum NVQ Level 3, City & Guilds or equivalent qualification in Heavy Vehicle Maintenance and Repair.
PSV/HGV background — Essential
Proven background as a skilled PSV/HGV mechanic with strong diagnostic capability.
Compliance knowledge — Essential
Strong understanding of DVSA standards, operator licence requirements and relevant vehicle inspection/manual requirements applicable to PSV/HGV operations.
Supervisory experience — Desirable
Previous supervisory or team-leading experience within a commercial workshop environment.
PCV licence — Desirable
Valid PCV Category D driving licence, where required for operational purposes.
Accreditation — Desirable
Active IRTEC accreditation.
Key competencies
Decisiveness
Makes timely, safe and commercially sound decisions under pressure.
Communication
Communicates clearly, confidently and supportively with engineering colleagues, operations stakeholders and management.
Technical authority
Leads by example on the tools, particularly in complex electrical, mechanical and diagnostic fault-finding.
Standard setting
Maintains high standards in vehicle safety, quality of work, housekeeping and workshop discipline.
Respectful leadership
Promotes a professional and inclusive working environment and addresses issues fairly, consistently and in line with company values and procedures.
Equal opportunities and reasonable adjustments
Arriva is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. Reasonable adjustments will be considered throughout the recruitment process and in role, where appropriate, in line with business needs and legal obligations.
Additional information
This job description describes the main duties and responsibilities of the role. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may be reviewed from time to time to reflect business, operational or legislative requirements.

The Head of Global Commercial Business Finance Operations is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving operational efficiency, process transformation, sales performance management and strategic initiatives within the company's Global Commercial Organization (GCO). This individual will serve as a key business partner to the Commercial Finance team in the regions and GCO leadership team, providing business insights, leading business operations functions, and ensuring the GCO operates effectively and achieves its revenue and profitability targets globally. This role requires a blend of strong financial acumen, operational expertise, strategic thinking and cross-functional leadership.
Key Responsibilities:
• Sales Performance Management: Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to global sales effectiveness, productivity, pipeline conversion, and sales efficiency. Analyze performance, identify trends and variances, and provide actionable insights to GCO leadership.
• Sales Compensation and Incentive Planning: Sitting in Commercial Incentives Committee, partner with Sales leadership and HR to design, implement, and analyze global sales compensation plans and incentive structures to drive desired sales behaviors and outcomes. Ensure alignment with financial targets and business strategy.
• Pricing Strategy Implementation: Support the implementation and execution of the company's global pricing strategies and structure. Establish and enforce global pricing rules and floors for special pricing, global/regional deals, ensuring effectiveness and alignment with policy / internal controls.
• Pricing Process Development and Management: Develop, document, and manage global pricing processes, including price list creation, discounting guidelines, approval workflows, and pricing communication to the sales team.
• Pricing Tools and Systems: Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of pricing tools and systems to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and ease of use for the sales organization.
• Channel Revenue Management:  Oversee global Channel revenue and Gross to Net process and tool management. Lead day to day operation of spend entry, quarter end close and process/tool improvement. • SOX Control and Compliance Oversight: Serve as the Business Process Owner (BPO) for critical sales operations SOX controls. Ensure the integrity of the global SOX environment by maintaining and enforcing transactional approval matrices and financial thresholds within systems
• Sales Operations Leadership: Oversee key global sales operations functions, including POS data management, sales reporting and analytics, territory management, and quota administration. Drive efficiency and effectiveness in sales execution.

• Team Leadership and Development: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team encompassing both sales operations professionals and transformation task forces within Finance across global regions.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with global Finance organizations (including accounting and FP&A), Legal, IT and other departments to ensure alignment and support the GCO's objectives.
• Strategic Project Management: Lead and manage strategic projects and initiatives within the GCO or Business Finance (such as GtN optimization), ensuring they are aligned with business goals and delivered effectively.

• Bachelor or Master degree in Finance, Accounting, Audit, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or relevant advanced degree is highly preferred.
• Minimum of 20 years of progressive experience in both finance and sales operations, with significant experience in a leadership role within a global organization.
• Deep understanding of sales processes, sales compensation models, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and sales data management.
• Proven track record of driving global process transformation, financial performance and operational improvements within a global sales organization.
• Experience in audit, internal control including design, implement and enhancement will be a plus.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills.
• Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to effectively interact with senior sales leadership.
• Proven leadership and team management skills, with experience building and managing cross-functional teams across geographies.
• Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Proficiency in CRM, sales analytics tools, and financial operation systems.
Personal Attributes:
• Strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong understanding of the sales operation function and commercial finance.
• Highly analytical and data-driven in decision-making.
• Excellent communicator and influencer, able to build credibility with sales leaders.
• Strong collaborator and team player.
• Proactive and takes initiative to identify and solve problems.
• Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic global sales environment.
• High integrity and ethical standards.

Job Description:
Join the Leonardo UK Helicopter Division, as a Project Controls Apprentice (Level 3).
Leonardo offers a range of Apprenticeships across a variety of STEM and business routes, offering paid training, coupled with on the job learning that enables you to gain practical skills, experience and knowledge that sets up the best start to your career. We offer competitive entry salaries and fully support your academic learning through to qualifications, with salary increases as you progress.
We support helping you settle into your new location ensuring you are familiar with the team and have a warm welcome from day 1. There is a member of our Apprentice team at each site, helping you progress, ensuring your study time is protected, enabling access to digital learning as well as opportunities to get involved with the local community and STEM projects, enhance many aspects of each programme.
The Apprenticeship:
Project Controls is a fundamental discipline to the safe and stable execution of projects and achieving business growth.  With a focus on scheduling, planning, risk management, resource management, performance metrics and change management, Project Controls provides a unique insight into the execution monitoring and control of Projects and is at the heart of successful delivery performance.  Successful completion of the apprenticeship may lead to roles such as Project Controller, Planner, with further progression opportunities towards Project Management like Project Officer, Project Manager and Programme Manager.
The Leonardo Helicopters Project Controls Apprenticeship is structured around a programme of placements that will see you move around within the Project Controls Function at Leonardo Helicopters Yeovil over a 3.5 year period and is designed to give you as much experience and exposure to Project Controls practices and different operational contexts as possible. This will help you develop strong core skills of Project Controls whilst also giving you a wider understanding of how a global business operates.
You will also undertake a Level 3 Project Controls Technician qualification over this time to compliment on the job learning alongside internal training to understand and utilise globally recognised tool sets and standards in Project Controls.
The programme aligns with the competencies defined by the Association for Project Management (APM) and supports further professional registration opportunities.
During your apprenticeship, you will:
• Grow your knowledge of an engineering business.
• Develop practical skills in manufacturing and understanding key processes and technologies.
• Support early careers activities - our apprentices have the opportunity to work as STEM ambassadors in schools, colleges and universities
Each Apprentice on this route will need to complete an End Point Assessment as defined in the Apprenticeship Standard, this will take place in the final months of the programme.
The programme aligns with the competencies defined by the Association for Project Management (APM) and supports further professional registration
opportunities.
You will develop competencies in:
• Project scheduling and planning using recognised software (e.g. SAP, MS Project, MS Office, SSI, Power BI)
• Risk identification and management
• Cost tracking and performance analysis (Earned Value Management)
• Change and configuration management processes
• Stakeholder reporting and project governance
What you’ll bring
You must have (as a minimum) the following qualifications:
• 5 GCSE grades 4 - 9 or grades A*- C or equivalent, to include Maths and English
Security Clearance
At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.
For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

We are looking for analytical engineers to deliver the MBDA Hardware In The Loop mission statement; “To provide operational confidence through world-class, closed loop missile performance testing”.
Salary: Up to £46,000 depending on experience.
Dynamic (hybrid) working: Predominately on-site (Stevenage) due to workload classification and nature of testing.
Security Clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship.
Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Security Check (SC).
What we can offer you:
• Company bonus: Up to £2,500 (based on company performance and will vary year to year)
• Pension: maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%
• Overtime: opportunity for paid overtime
• Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days
• Flexible working: We welcome applicants who are looking for flexible working arrangements
• Enhanced parental leave: offers up to 26 weeks for maternity, adoption and shared parental leave -enhancements are available for paternity leave, neonatal leave and fertility testing and treatments
• Facilities: Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more…
The opportunity:
You will join the Hardware In The Loop (HWIL) team who conduct dynamic missile firing simulations, utilising real missile hardware in support of; product development, performance validation and firing trial preparation.
You will have the opportunity to work within a state-of-the-art test and evaluation facility, unique within the UK. The HWIL testing utilises; real missile hardware, a missile performance model, flight motion tables [to pitch/roll/yaw the hardware] and RF / IR target generation systems [to represent target(s)]. This dynamic testing is controlled by a HWIL developed simulation which runs real-time.
This test and evaluation setup allows HWIL to conduct missile testing across many MBDA products in as close to real world scenarios as possible, exercising missile functionalities such as; in-flight performance, target detection, acquisition and homing.
Your job role may vary with the lifecycle of the missile products you are supporting. Your overall aim will be to; integrate, understand and maintain highly complex simulations, and utilise these to perform missile testing and data analysis – all in support of missile product development.
Your main responsibilities will be to:
•             Understand functionality of the missile sub-systems involved in dynamic HWIL testing,
•             Understand interactions between the missile sub-systems and bespoke test equipment,
•             Interact with relevant subject matter experts across MBDA missile product teams,
•             Develop real time software simulations utilising performance models,
•             Conduct hands-on testing with real missile hardware and software,
•             Analyse missile telemetry data to understand performance and produce technical reports.
What we're looking for from you:
We have found that the best HWIL engineers have wide engineering experience, with knowledge in some (not necessarily all) of the areas listed below:
•             System integration & interface debugging,
•             Structured approach to problem solving,
•             Real time software / simulation design,
•             Testing of sensors or sub-systems,
•             Experience with Radio Frequency or InfraRed seekers,
•             System performance analysis.
Our company: Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given
MBDA is a leading defence organisation.  We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom.

You will take ownership of defined analytical projects, with support from experienced colleagues on more complex methodological and strategic questions, and build increasing independence and influence.
Your work will span incrementality testing, marketing mix modelling (MMM), and understanding why realised returns differ from predictions. You will work closely with buying teams, analysts, and technical partners to connect evidence across measurement approaches and help assess Performance Marketing alongside the wider marketing mix. A sister team focuses on model training infrastructure and production pipelines; your focus will be on analytical rigour, interpretation, and applying findings to business decisions.
Your Role Within Our Kingdom
• Connect Measurement to Business Value: You will translate analytical findings into practical recommendations on marketing investment, campaign optimisation, and performance expectations. You will work with stakeholders to connect marketing outcomes to player behaviour and revenue, and follow through to understand whether recommendations improve decisions.
• Deliver Marketing Measurement: You will design and analyse incrementality tests and contribute to MMM and other causal analyses, selecting appropriate approaches with guidance where needed. You will own defined projects from the initial business question through analysis, interpretation, and stakeholder readout.
• Explain Business Performance: You will investigate where and why ROI is over- or under-predicted, distinguishing changes in player value, campaign mix, measurement assumptions, and underlying business performance. You will help stakeholders understand whether a gap calls for action, further investigation, or more time to gather evidence.
• Turn Evidence into Decision Frameworks: You will help translate experiment and model outputs into calibration inputs, performance benchmarks, and repeatable analytical tools. You will bring together evidence from incrementality, attribution, and MMM to support planning and evaluate Performance Marketing within the wider marketing mix.
• Bridge Business and Technical Questions: You will work with marketing stakeholders to frame actionable questions and with technical partners to define data and analytical requirements. You will help ensure measurement outputs are interpreted correctly and used effectively in day-to-day decisions.
• Communicate Clearly and Improve Our Approach: You will explain findings, assumptions, and uncertainty to technical and non-technical audiences. You will challenge inconsistencies, identify opportunities to improve existing approaches, and take on broader ownership as your expertise develops.
Skills to Create Thrills
• Education: Degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience: Hands-on experience in data science, analytics, experimentation, or marketing measurement, with examples of taking an analytical question through to a useful business recommendation.
• Statistical Foundations: A solid understanding of statistical modelling, hypothesis testing, experimentation, and the distinction between correlation and causation. Practical experience with at least one relevant measurement approach and an interest in developing broader expertise.
• Execution: Able to independently deliver well-scoped analytical work, validate results, and manage priorities. Comfortable working through ambiguity while recognising when to seek input or challenge the original question.
• Commercial Mindset: Curious about what drives business performance and able to connect analytical results to investment choices, expected returns, and practical actions.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python or R and SQL, with experience working with complex datasets and producing clear, reproducible analyses.
• Communication: Able to explain complex findings in accessible language, make recommendations supported by evidence, and communicate uncertainty without losing the practical message.
• Judgement and Growth: Thoughtful about assumptions, data quality, and methodological limitations. Receptive to feedback, quick to learn, and ready to develop towards broader project ownership and greater influence over business decisions.
Tasty Bonus Points
• Experience working with media buying teams, growth marketing, or other commercial stakeholders.
• Familiarity with MMM, GeoLift, holdout testing, synthetic controls, or other causal inference methods.
• Experience analysing ROI, lifetime value, forecast accuracy, or the drivers of changes in commercial performance.
• Understanding of advertising measurement challenges, including attribution bias, selection effects, organic cannibalisation, and platform limitations.
• Exposure to measuring brand or traditional marketing alongside digital Performance Marketing.
• Experience turning analysis into repeatable tools or processes used in planning, forecasting, or optimisation.
• Familiarity with BigQuery, Looker, or similar data and analytics platforms.
• Passion for gaming and curiosity about how player behaviour translates into long-term business value.
About King
With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. The Vacancy
We are always looking for exceptional individuals to join our multinational group of talented professionals and right now we are seeking to recruit a motivated and talented Electronics Technician to join our PCB Test Team.
In this role, you will support the board-level assembly, testing, inspection, fault-finding, repair and rework of printed circuit boards (PCBs) within our busy manufacturing and production environment. You will be responsible for diagnosing electronic faults at component and board level, carrying out repairs and rework, and ensuring products meet the required quality, reliability and performance standards. You will also work closely with Engineering and Quality teams to investigate defects and contribute to continuous improvement activities.
Please note this is a full-time shift-based role (37 hours per week), working on a two-week rotating shift pattern and attracts a 20% shift allowance.
Key Responsibilities
• Carry out automated and dedicated testing of PCB assemblies in accordance with test procedures and specifications.
• Diagnose electronic faults at component and board level using schematics, PCB layouts, technical documentation and electronic test equipment.
• Carry out SMD and through-hole soldering, desoldering, component replacement and PCB rework and repairs.
• Use equipment including multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies and signal generators to identify and investigate electronic faults.
• Accurately record and log faults using Computer Aided Repair systems and support root-cause investigations and corrective actions.
• Work closely with Engineering and Quality teams to investigate manufacturing and product defects.
• Ensure all work is completed in accordance with company procedures, quality standards and applicable manufacturing requirements.
• Support continuous improvement activities to improve manufacturing efficiency, product quality and reliability.
Experience, Skills & Qualifications
• Previous experience in PCB soldering, repair and rework, including SMD and through-hole components, is essential.
• Ability to read and interpret circuit schematics, PCB layouts, engineering drawings and technical documentation.
• Experience using electronic test and measurement equipment, such as multimeters and oscilloscopes.
• Good computer skills with the ability to accurately record and enter data.
• Good manual dexterity and attention to detail.
About Us

Experience of managing a large and varied portfolio of indirect / VAT tax clients.

Your impact
We have an opportunity for a skilled Lead Electronics Engineer to join the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP) team to be based in our Edinburgh. You will have responsibility for the electronics development of a key  array subsystem within the Team Tempest demonstrator Multi-Function Antenna. This UK-only project is a key part of the overall GCAP programme and will be part of the flight trials programme on Leonardo's 757 trials aircraft, Excalibur. This is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to play a fundamental role in a defence programme of critical national importance, and to shape the future of Combat Air capability in the UK.
The role is varied but focusses on the design, integration and test of the radar array subsystem and a number of inter-connected multi-layer printed circuit board assemblies.  As a Lead Electronics Engineer, you will be responsible for creating high quality and robust electronics designs; for fully documenting and recording your work products; ensuring all certification processes are adhered to and documented; keeping the design under configuration management and providing plans and reports on progress.
The role is broad in scope and covering a wide variety of activities, from design through test and integration to certification. With a diverse mix of skills already in the team, this role can be tailored to suit the right applicant.  This will be a very ‘hands-on’ role with focus on hardware prototyping, lab measurement, debugging, integration, testing and validation of the full array sub-system. As a result, this will be a hybrid working role, with approximately 60% of your working hours working in the Edinburgh office.
What you’ll bring
With this role, your key areas of responsibility will be:
•
Hardware requirements management.
•
Functional design, verification and validation of the array subsystem.
•
Technical leadership of design engineers through the lifecycle.
•
Ownership of the electronics work package activities within the array subsystem.
•
Developing and completing plans for subsystem level integration and verification.
•
Contributing towards LRI integration and verification plans.
•
Production of material for design reviews.
•
Chairing of design reviews within the Physical Hardware Design Process.
•
Mentoring and supervision of more junior team members.
With this role, you will develop in the following areas:
•
Domain Knowledge: you will apply and develop your knowledge of complex electronics systems in a fast-paced and dynamic development team.
•
Continuous Learning: you’ll be supported in your ongoing professional development though training and mentoring, in engineering lifecycle processes, leadership, or your own personal development.
•
Teamwork: you will work alongside like-minded professional engineers in a highly collaborative environment.
•

Are you passionate about helping others and providing exceptional customer service?
